lines.say: Someone just signed your lease. And he has your face.
Your key stopped working at noon. Your name is still on the door.
The landlord texts. Welcome home, tenant nine D.
You knock. A voice inside says, I'm busy.
The door opens. He looks exactly like you. Only happier.
He pays your rent on time. Better than you.
The landlord says, one tenant per name.
Would you fight for your name? Write it in the comments.
